label: InferenceX, reconstructed recipe, G4
note: InferenceX points of Llama-3.3-70B (benchmark_run ids are InferenceX workflow runs) whose launch the run did not record: the recipe was reconstructed from the benchmark scripts of the day. Scored by the same harness, graded G4 at best with the substitutions named below, and kept apart from the regular counts.
